content.title: MX-U (Mixed-Use, Urban) District
content.summary: The MX-U (Mixed-Use, Urban) District aims to facilitate a blend of residential and non-residential uses in urban settings, promoting multi-story buildings with pedestrian-friendly environments and access to public transportation. Various use classifications are outlined, including residential, hospitality, commercial, community, industrial, motor vehicle, and utility uses, each with specific allowances and regulations as defined in the Land Development Code. If a use is not specified in the guidelines, it is not permitted in this zoning district.
content.body:
Intended to provide for a variety of residential and non-residential uses, in vertically mixed-use, horizontally mixed-use, or single-use configurations with an urban character; and encourage vertical and horizontal mixed-use multi-story buildings with pedestrian friendly streetscapes, public amenities, and good access to public transportation.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
